**Summary for Knowledge Base**

Qedma Quantum Computing has announced an integration of its advanced quantum error‑mitigation software with Nvidia’s CUDA‑Q framework, aiming to improve reliability and performance of quantum algorithms on GPU-accelerated hardware. The collaboration leverages CUDA‑Q’s support for quantum circuit simulation and hybrid quantum–classical workflow management. This development is reported by global news aggregators sourced through Google News.
